# Chapters

Chapters are released one at a time.  
Each chapter has its own note here and its own folder of game data.

## How chapters connect

Your save tracks the current chapter and any flags set so far.  
When a chapter ends the game looks for the next numbered folder.  
If the folder is missing it shows a short message and waits.
